newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Metra 8-mth profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Metra 8-mth profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 515 million markka median forecast for diversified engineering group Oy Metra Ab's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 9 at 0830/0530 GMT.
In January-August 1995, Metra posted a 392 million markka profit.

For Metra'full-year 1996 profit, 11 of the 13 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 1,007 million markka (mean 971 million) in a 765-1,070 million markka range. The 1995 profit was 795 million markka.
The data was collected in the fourth week of September and on October 4.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Enskilda, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
